title: CITERIFT Stage 04 evidence batch, version 1
description: Owner decision D-053: a content-addressed, immutable blob of complete Stage 04 evidence items, committed by one evidence_batch_recorded journal record. The items of one attempt are in the deterministic dependency order of SPEC 8.8 (every reference precedes the item that names it; among the items ready at a point, the smallest evidence id comes first) and are cut into batches by the byte ceiling of SPEC 8.8. Evidence ids are unique and follow D-051. Order, ids, references and boundaries are checked by Investigation Memory on append and on open; a missing or corrupt batch is corruption, never an empty batch.

order.description: The ordering rule the items follow (SPEC 8.8).
